macro_markets.query: What are the most important macroeconomic and stock market news and developments from the past 24 hours? Include major index movements, Fed/central bank news, and significant company earnings or announcements.

items.title: Global stocks fall as oil jumps and Treasury yields rise
items.summary: Global stocks declined on Monday as renewed US-Iran tensions pushed oil higher and the Treasury market signaled investors were bracing for more pressure on risk assets. Reuters said the selloff was broad, with futures and major equity gauges under pressure.

items.title: US stock futures point lower ahead of the Wall Street open
items.summary: U.S. equity futures were weaker, with S&P 500, Dow, and Nasdaq futures all down in early trading. Newsquawk and Yahoo Finance both pointed to a risk-off tone as investors weighed geopolitical tensions and higher yields.

items.title: Fed leaves rates unchanged at 5.25% to 5.50%
items.summary: The Federal Reserve held the federal funds rate steady, matching market expectations, and Powell's press conference followed the decision. Market coverage framed the move as a key driver for rate-sensitive assets and future policy expectations.

items.title: Bank of Canada holds rates at 2.25%; widening rate gap with the U.S. in focus
items.summary: Canadian dollar trading was pressured by the Bank of Canada’s decision to hold its policy rate at 2.25%, with markets watching the widening U.S.-Canada rate differential. Traders also continue to price the possibility of an October Fed hike.

items.title: Swiss National Bank keeps policy rate at 0.00%
items.summary: The SNB left interest rates unchanged at 0.00% and said it remains willing to act in foreign exchange markets if needed to maintain appropriate monetary conditions. The decision added to the broader central-bank focus on inflation and currency stability.

items.title: Treasury yields remain elevated, with the 30-year near multiyear highs
items.summary: Coverage highlighted the 30-year Treasury yield rising to around 5.53%, the highest level since 2004, as bond markets adjusted to tighter-for-longer policy expectations. Elevated yields were cited as a headwind for equities, especially growth stocks.

items.title: Mortgage rates rise above 7.1%
items.summary: The average 30-year fixed mortgage rate climbed above 7.1% for the first time in more than two years, reinforcing concerns about housing affordability and the broader impact of higher rates on consumers. This adds to the rate-sensitive macro backdrop facing markets.

items.title: China industrial profits cool while markets watch for China policy signals
items.summary: China’s industrial profits rose 15.7% year over year in August, down from 17.6% previously, suggesting some moderation in corporate earnings momentum. The calendar also showed follow-on attention to policy and trade developments involving China and the U.S.

items.title: U.S. economic data and Fed speeches keep policy expectations in focus
items.summary: Investors tracked a stream of U.S. releases and Fed speeches, including Dallas Fed manufacturing data and remarks from Barkin and Collins, as markets look for clues on the next policy move. These updates fed expectations around the October rate path.

items.title: Oil spikes on Middle East tensions, adding to inflation concerns
items.summary: Oil prices rose sharply as the stalemate in U.S.-Iran talks intensified market anxiety, with analysts warning the move could keep inflation pressure elevated. Higher crude was also cited as a contributor to weaker equity performance.

crypto_news.query: What are the most significant cryptocurrency and blockchain news from the past 24 hours? Include major price movements, regulatory news, and notable project developments.

items.title: Bitcoin slips to around $83K as risk sentiment weakens
items.summary: Bitcoin traded near $83,000 after falling roughly 1% to 2.1% over 24 hours, with reports tying the move to renewed U.S.-Iran tensions and broader pressure on risk assets. Ethereum also eased lower, while several altcoins declined in tandem.

items.title: Crypto market sees heavy liquidations as longs get squeezed
items.summary: Crypto markets recorded about $236 million to $270 million in 24-hour liquidations, with longs accounting for most of the wipeout. The move reflects elevated leverage and sharper intraday price swings across major tokens.

items.title: Bitget resumes withdrawals after major hot-wallet breach
items.summary: Bitget began gradually resuming withdrawals after attackers drained about $387.5 million from its hot and warm wallets. Investigators suspect North Korean involvement, and the breach is described as the largest crypto hack so far this year.

items.title: Binance announces five new USDT-margined perpetual contracts
items.summary: Binance said it will list five new USDT-margined perpetual contracts, including OKLOUSDT, TWSTUSDT, CVNAUSDT, RUMUSDT and XOMUSDT, with leverage up to 20x. The listings are scheduled sequentially within a 20-minute window.

items.title: Hong Kong expands crypto and financial oversight coordination
items.summary: Hong Kong’s AFRC and SFC signed a memorandum to broaden cooperation across licensed firms, virtual asset trading platforms, funds, audits, information sharing, referrals, inspections and joint investigations. The move signals tighter coordination in the city’s regulatory framework.

items.title: California signs two crypto-related bills
items.summary: California Governor Gavin Newsom signed AB 2409 and SB 1208, covering restrictions on public-official meme coins and procedures for crypto-related money laundering and asset seizures. The laws add another layer to U.S. state-level crypto regulation.

items.title: Strategy and Strive keep adding bitcoin to corporate treasuries
items.summary: Strategy and Strive reportedly bought 2,773 BTC worth about $232 million for their corporate treasuries, while Strive separately added 1,107 BTC for about $94.5 million. These purchases highlight continued institutional accumulation despite softer prices.

items.title: Solana ETF inflows reach record level amid strong network activity
items.summary: Solana ETF inflows hit a record $1.22 billion, alongside new highs in onchain transactions and memecoin volume. The trend points to renewed investor attention on Solana-linked products and activity.

items.title: Ethereum project Eureka Labs raises $6.7 million for programmable blocks
items.summary: Ethereum block builder Eureka Labs raised $6.7 million and introduced 'programmable blocks.' The development adds to ongoing infrastructure investment in Ethereum’s builder and execution ecosystem.

gaming.query: What are the most notable video game and gaming industry news from the past 24 hours? Include game releases, announcements, esports, and industry developments.

items.title: Game industry roundup: Sony teases God of War Deluxe Edition details, War Dogs sales surge, and more
items.summary: Recent gaming coverage highlights Sony’s pre-order and Deluxe Edition details for God of War Laufey’s release, alongside reporting that Wardogs has sold 3 million copies and its developers are now taking forced holidays due to being overwhelmed by demand.

items.title: Konami marks Castlevania’s 40th anniversary with classic mobile releases
items.summary: Konami has released classic Castlevania titles on iOS and Android to commemorate the franchise’s 40th anniversary, according to recent gaming news coverage.

items.title: New free Steam release: Hyperboard Extreme launches on PC
items.summary: A newly released free-to-play PC title, Hyperboard Extreme, is now available on Steam and is being highlighted in recent Japanese gaming coverage as a fast-paced hoverboard battle-racing game.

items.title: New hardware announcement: compact high-performance GPU-ready desktop unveiled
items.summary: Japanese gaming and tech coverage reports a new desktop system from Thirdwave’s E-series, positioned for gaming, creative work, and AI use with an emphasis on quiet operation and cooling.

items.title: AI and matchmaking patent news from Sony
items.summary: Recent gaming industry reporting says Sony has patented an advanced matchmaking system that gathers detailed player data using AI, reflecting continued investment in AI-driven game services.

items.title: SAG-AFTRA videogame strike impacts the industry
items.summary: Gaming coverage notes that the SAG-AFTRA videogame strike is now in effect over AI-related concerns, with the dispute raising the risk of delays across multiple projects.

items.title: Japanese game subscription and DLC chatter spreads on social media
items.summary: Realtime Japanese social posts indicate new subscription availability for a game soundtrack/service called '恋GAME,' with listeners reacting quickly after it appeared on Apple Music and Amazon Music.

items.title: Korean game industry news: user-rights MOU, Warframe update, and Red Desert nominations
items.summary: Recent Korean gaming coverage reports a user-rights protection agreement among gaming organizations, the release of a major Warframe update, and Red Desert Enhanced receiving Golden Joystick Award nominations.

tech_news.query: What are the most important technology news and developments from the past 24 hours? Include major product launches, company news, and significant tech industry developments. Exclude AI-specific news.

items.title: Apple ordered to pay $5.7 billion in haptics patent verdict
items.summary: A U.S. jury awarded Taction Technology more than $5.7 billion in damages after finding Apple infringed haptics patents tied to the iPhone. Apple said it will appeal and denied using Taction’s technology.

items.title: Microsoft reportedly reboots Copilot after abandoning personal chatbot push
items.summary: A Hacker News Mirror roundup says Microsoft is backing away from a personal AI chatbot race and relaunching Copilot with a different strategy. The item did not include full details, but it indicates a notable shift in Microsoft’s consumer product direction.

items.title: Discord rolls out global age checks
items.summary: TNW reported that Discord is implementing worldwide age checks that automatically sort most users. The move signals a broader shift in platform safety and identity verification policies.

items.title: SpaceX set for first attempt to put Starship into Earth orbit
items.summary: France 24 reported that SpaceX is preparing its first attempt to send Starship into Earth orbit. If successful, it would mark a major milestone for the rocket program and the commercial space industry.

items.title: Nvidia unveils security platform for AI agents
items.summary: Associated Press coverage says Nvidia launched a security platform aimed at preventing AI agents from acting outside intended boundaries. The release underscores growing industry concern about agentic software safety and control.

items.title: TikTok settles Alabama lawsuit for at least $100 million
items.summary: AP reported that TikTok agreed to pay Alabama at least $100 million and add new safety features as part of a settlement. The deal resolves an impending trial and adds to the company’s regulatory pressures in the U.S.
